receipt.result_detail: residual entropy anatomy of the exact S8 winner residual over 8 effectiveness clips and of 42 representative Phase-M channel streams; conditional entropies in bits per residual sample under 11 decoder-visible contexts (held-out Mode C untouched); result sha256 a21c2bea098a4483631f5416a81771d4a3a1fbbc0c92bce1884eeb338a6a98dc
limitations: learned prediction is an experimental profile: it does not change u1/v1, the literal fallback remains mandatory, and negative learned results are preserved rather than hidden
a plug-in conditional entropy is an optimistic estimate when a context is sparse; the per-context cardinalities are reported so the reader can judge dilution
the matched-lag context is an oracle ceiling, not a decoder-free quantity
the Phase-M population uses a cheaper predictor than voice does; it exists only to test whether a context family carries information outside speech
this is a diagnostic, not a codec: no representation, profile or format is changed and no compression claim is made

method.binarization: sign bit, then Exp-Golomb(0) of |r|: v=|r|+1, (bit_length(v)-1) zero bits, then the bits of v MSB-first
method.estimator: plug-in empirical conditional entropy in bits per residual sample; context cardinalities are reported so sparse-context optimism is visible
method.matched_lag: oracle upper bound chosen per residual from its own autocorrelation (1..=128); a coder would transmit it
method.disagreement: selected predictor hypothesis minus the previous reconstructed sample
method.speech_predictor: the active S8 portfolio winner, unchanged
method.phase_m_predictor: cheap exact fixed-difference closure over the frozen block ladder, per deinterleaved channel
method.mode_c: deliberately not measured (held out from architecture tuning)
method.format_change: none: this court only decodes existing residuals

protocol.semantic_authority: none: a learned hypothesis is a candidate family, never truth; scalar exact closure decides acceptance
